InklingMD

A WYSIWYG Markdown editor built with Tauri and Milkdown. ✨

Features

  • Live preview with GFM tables
  • Math via KaTeX
    • inline and block formulas
  • Smart Paste
  • Plugin system

Install

pnpm install
pnpm tauri dev
Shortcut Action
Ctrl+P Quick open

Note See CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR.
